context: Tests that Step 4g's rebrand color verification is a hard gate before Step 5. A stale state file says rebrand is done, but fixture CSS still contains the old cream/filter colors and old action reds. The agent must fix/check those surfaces and must not run asset enrichment before the color gate is verified.

checklist.name: Root palette and secondary buttons no longer use old brand colors
checklist.description: styles/styles.css no longer contains the old cream or old action red literals (#F4E9DC, #95351D, #7a2b17).

checklist.name: Facets panel winning background is fixed
checklist.description: blocks/search-results/styles/facets.css no longer contains the old hardcoded facets/filter cream #FBF1EA.

checklist.name: Search UI old cream/red literals are cleared
checklist.description: The search-results/search-bar/add-to-collection UI files in the fixture no longer contain the old cream or old action red literals.

checklist.name: Does not start asset enrichment before the color gate
checklist.description: The agent does not invoke the enrichment command in the same turn while the color verification gate is still being repaired/verified.

checklist.name: Treats deployed preview color verification as required before assets
checklist.description: The agent explains that the deployed preview/facets-panel verification must pass before moving to asset enrichment, rather than treating local edits alone as enough.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced unnecessarily to the customer.
